findings.title: Nonorthonormal directions change the response operator
findings.evidence: A=J D and B=D are returned without D^T D=I; tensor prediction uses A B^T. Scalar J=1,D=2 predicts 4, not 1.
findings.minimal_repair: Mirror finite orthonormal basis validation or explicitly use the dual basis.

findings.title: Exact KV mode applies learned projections
findings.evidence: Identity backend metadata still allowed key/value projection 2I, changing values while claimed exact.
findings.minimal_repair: Exact mode rejects projection/phase parameters and passes through positioned tensor identities; approximate mode retains learned maps.

findings.title: Operator frame mismatch passes typed compilation
findings.evidence: APPLY_OPERATOR checks only kinds and output state preservation, not operator coordinate frame/dimension or actual bound packet metadata.
findings.minimal_repair: Require operator/state boundary type equality and validate runtime bindings against declared types.

findings.title: Missing participant metadata is accepted
findings.evidence: Two branches with structure_ids=(s,) and empty commutation_classes pass initial validation.
findings.minimal_repair: Require one structure and commutation record per branch; preserve independent read/write checks.

findings.title: Undefined gradient estimator enum blocks import
findings.evidence: PATHWISE and SCORE_FUNCTION are absent from core GradientEstimator; four top-level references would raise AttributeError.
findings.minimal_repair: Use existing EXACT/POLICY_GRADIENT members and add static enum consistency checks.

findings.title: Empty-mask output contradicts loss ledger
findings.evidence: Default masked_tensor_mean policy returns LossValue skip objects despite ledger promising differentiable_zero.
findings.minimal_repair: Pass zero_valid_policy explicitly on every loss reduction.

findings.title: Left-padding loss predicts from masked pad
findings.evidence: P=1, token mask=(False,True), label y: backend physical shift trains y from pad logit 1 instead of visible prefix logit 0.
findings.minimal_repair: Gather each label from previous visible causal position and count only valid predicted labels.

findings.title: Covariance head is disconnected from promised objective
findings.evidence: Dedicated covariance_weight head produces uncertainty, but loss accepts no covariance and ledger claims position/covariance error.
findings.minimal_repair: Add a masked uncertainty loss with exact denominator and parameter owner.

findings.title: Entity/reference pointer is not registered as dependency
findings.evidence: ObjectRef(value) is constructed and discarded; value remains str, invisible to recursive ObjectRegistry dependency validation.
findings.minimal_repair: Retain typed target reference or explicitly validate/declare targets before symbol authority.

findings.title: Semantic discrepancy can be treated as numeric repair
findings.evidence: IDs/digests match but kind and report/session versions are not checked; a semantic_domain report can drive numeric state addition.
findings.minimal_repair: Bind report/repair kind, all semantic versions, source frame and evidence retractions before application.

findings.title: Hard policy has no selected live log probability
findings.evidence: Hard mode returns deterministic argmax one-hot while dedicated loss/config require POLICY_GRADIENT logprob; controller discards probability graph.
findings.minimal_repair: Separate stochastic policy from deterministic hard evaluation and return selected action plus live log probability.

findings.title: Derived grant survives parent revocation
findings.evidence: Confirmed finite source execution: narrow p to c, revoke p, resolve c succeeds. Parent lineage is not retained.
findings.minimal_repair: Track parent grants and enforce revocation transitively.

findings.title: Edge obstruction IDs are misused as domain IDs
findings.evidence: H26 GluingCandidate.conflict_witness lists edge IDs; H23 copies that tuple to conflicting_domains. A legitimate single-edge obstruction yields one string and is rejected as fewer than two domains.
findings.minimal_repair: Bind the source SheafPacket and resolve witness edges to endpoint domain IDs; retain edge witness meaning.
